name: Palo Dinner Sliced Herbed Yellowfin Tuna Carpaccio
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
whyItWorks: Paper-thin sushi-grade yellowfin tuna is pure, zero-fiber protein when dressed in plain extra-virgin olive oil instead of lemon.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the kitchen to dress your Sliced Yellowfin Tuna with extra-virgin olive oil and sea salt only—holding any lemon juice or citrus emulsion.
watchOuts: Lemon dressing on default build (request olive oil only)
